metaTitle: Custom Faux Leather Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom faux leather embroidered patches for a vintage look. Perfect for uniforms, bags, and apparel. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Faux leather embroidered patches offer a sophisticated, vintage-inspired look that stands out from standard fabric patches. The subtle texture and rich depth of faux leather make these patches ideal for corporate uniforms, trade show giveaways, or branded apparel where you want a premium feel without animal products. Decorate them with your logo using embroidery or debossing for a durable, professional finish that holds up to daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom faux leather embroidered patches with embroidered logo on a dark background
